done_when: The guide test checks the guide's sections for new and existing repos instead of copied phrases, the retry and upgrade-version tests run at the command boundary, and the net-lines limit test has a name that says what it guards

findings.body: Raise: Functional. This test-only fix changes the repository pin from v1.2.12 to v1.2.10. `check_pin` in `src/forge/repo.py:724-782` routes normal Forge commands to the pinned release, so commands in this checkout run older behavior. `tests/test_release_version.py:16` also requires v1.2.12. The hook and workflow headers were downgraded alongside the pin.
findings.title: Restore the Forge v1.2.12 pin

findings.body: Raise: Security. Both changed Forge guides remove the instruction to deploy only after an explicit request and to verify authentication first. The changed demo guidance also calls a merged version “live” before deployment is verified. `src/forge/templates/skill.md:11-21` still contains the authorization rule, and `tests/test_deployment_requires_an_explicit_request.py:79-89` requires it in both host guides. Agents using this checkout now receive conflicting deployment instructions.
findings.title: Restore explicit deployment authorization in both checked-in guides

findings.body: Raise: Gate. The generated guide and command page drop `forge land --all` even though the current template still documents it at `src/forge/templates/skill.md:41` and the command remains covered by `tests/test_queue_land_all.py`. The guides also drop the `always_test` instruction required by `tests/test_close_always_tests.py:100-104`. These unrelated generated-file rollbacks leave agents with incomplete instructions for supported commands and settings.
findings.title: Gate: retain current coordinator commands in generated guidance

findings.body: Raise: Gate. The supplied latest-commit proof list says only “generated files only.” It names no proof for any Done-when detail: guide sections in new and previously adopted repos, command-boundary retry behavior, command-boundary upgrade-version behavior, or the net-lines test name. The changed tests are present, but none is mapped to its claimed item in the required proof list.
findings.title: Not done: proof list

why: The test audit left four follow-ups: a guide test copying about 110 phrases, two tests importing Forge internals in a subprocess, and a CI test named for Windows that guards another job
